headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 14, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY, with an average return of 26.76% compared to SPY's 13.40%. This 13.37% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a return of 43.08%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned only 4.67%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. Outperforming SPY during this period can signal resilience amid broader market conditions, making this performance particularly relevant. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
